context: Add viewport-fit=cover, then work outward from the edges. Give the app shell horizontal and top safe-area padding as well as bottom, since cover exposes all four insets. Re-check every route at notched-device dimensions in both orientations, and confirm the trays' inset padding now resolves to a real value. Landscape is the case most likely to break: left and right insets become non-zero and the facet rail and wide tables sit against them.
description:
Implements Phase 0 decision D6, recorded on rx-ux-00.

Today index.html:23 declares `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">` with no `viewport-fit=cover`, so env(safe-area-inset-*) resolves to 0 everywhere and the fixed selection trays cannot overlap an iOS home indicator. rx-ux-01 therefore installs the --bb-inset-bottom seam but deliberately leaves it inert, and its scope rules forbid touching index.html.

D6 decided to adopt viewport-fit=cover. That is a change to the layout viewport for EVERY route, not a tray fix: content can extend under the status bar, the home indicator and the rounded corners, so the header, the Explorer sub-nav, the facet rail, every table container and the footer all need re-checking. This item owns that change and its consequences; rx-ux-01 keeps its inert-seam scope unchanged.

The owner accepted the stated risk: a global layout change to fix one overlay defect.

anti_patterns.dont: add viewport-fit=cover and only pad the tray
anti_patterns.instead: pad the app shell on all four edges and re-check every route
anti_patterns.why: cover exposes left, right and top insets too; a tray-only fix leaves content under the notch and the rounded corners

anti_patterns.instead: make worktree-create BRANCH=... WORKTREE_PATH=... then make agent-write-preflight
anti_patterns.why: AGENTS.md makes the primary clone read-only for agents

anti_patterns.dont: hard-code pixel values for the insets
anti_patterns.instead: use env() with a max() fallback
anti_patterns.why: inset sizes differ per device and change between OS versions
landscape is where left/right insets become non-zero and the facet rail and wide tables sit against them

preserves.behavior: Existing desktop layout at >= 48rem must be visually unchanged; cover affects mobile viewports
The @media print rules added by rx-ux-01 and rx-ux-20
